description: This file appears to be a control script for an automated robotic system, managing various fixture handling, testing, and communication with external devices via modbus and socket interfaces. It includes functions for movement, speed settings, fixture picking, placing, and error handling, indicating it orchestrates a complex automation process.
external_files: robot movement commands (MovP, MovL, RZ, RX, RY, Z, Y, etc.)
